limitations: Finite-dimensional orthogonal projectors are assumed, \(\sum_iP_i\succ0\), and the bias estimate is asymptotic as \(\lambda\downarrow0\). No uniform finite-\(\lambda\) constant, floating-point theorem, or solver-speed advantage is claimed. Popa (1995) remains a residual full-text coverage risk.
provenance: A second-order expansion of the affine cyclic sweep around strong underrelaxation, followed by a residual identity that makes opposite block orders cancel at first order.
record_title: Reverse-order averaging cancels first-order underrelaxation bias in cyclic block Kaczmarz
